type_text:
∀ (L σ ε : ℝ) (n s : ℕ),
  0 < s →
    s ≤ n →
      0 < L →
        OracleTemplate.BirchMethods.cycleStep L σ ε n s = OracleTemplate.BirchMethods.chainStep L σ ε (2 * ↑n ^ 2 / ↑s)
